installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Youer (MohistMC) Installation Script
# Uses the current API: https://api.mohistmc.com/project/youer/{version}/builds
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
PROJECT=youer

if [ -n "${DL_PATH}" ]; then
	echo -e "Using supplied download url: ${DL_PATH}"
	DOWNLOAD_URL=`eval echo $(echo ${DL_PATH} | sed -e 's/{{/${/g' -e 's/}}/}/g')`
else
	echo -e "Fetching builds for ${PROJECT} ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}..."
	BUILDS_JSON=$(curl -s --max-time 30 "https://api.mohistmc.com/project/${PROJECT}/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds")

	if [ -z "$BUILDS_JSON" ] || ! echo "$BUILDS_JSON" | jq -e 'type == "array"' >/dev/null 2>&1; then
		echo -e "ERROR: Could not fetch builds from the MohistMC API."
		echo -e "Tried: https://api.mohistmc.com/project/${PROJECT}/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds"
		echo -e "Response was empty or not a JSON array. Check the version or try again later."
		exit 1
	fi

	# Newest build is the first element in the array
	if [ -z "${BUILD_NUMBER}" ] || [ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" = "latest" ]; then
		BUILD_NUMBER=$(echo "$BUILDS_JSON" | jq -r '.[0].id')
		echo -e "Using latest build: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
	else
		# Check whether the requested build id exists
		EXISTS=$(echo "$BUILDS_JSON" | jq -r --arg id "${BUILD_NUMBER}" '.[] | select(.id == ($id | tonumber)) | .id' | head -n1)
		if [ -n "$EXISTS" ] && [ "$EXISTS" != "null" ]; then
			echo -e "Build ${BUILD_NUMBER} is valid."
		else
			BUILD_NUMBER=$(echo "$BUILDS_JSON" | jq -r '.[0].id')
			echo -e "Build not found, falling back to latest: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
		fi
	fi

	if [ -z "${BUILD_NUMBER}" ] || [ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" = "null" ]; then
		echo -e "ERROR: Could not determine a valid build id."
		exit 1
	fi

	echo "Version being downloaded"
	echo -e "Project: ${PROJECT}"
	echo -e "MC Version: ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
	echo -e "Build: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
	DOWNLOAD_URL="https://api.mohistmc.com/project/${PROJECT}/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER}/download"
fi

cd /mnt/server

echo -e "Running curl -o ${SERVER_JARFILE} ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

if [ -f ${SERVER_JARFILE} ]; then
	mv ${SERVER_JARFILE} ${SERVER_JARFILE}.old
fi

curl -f -L --max-time 180 -o ${SERVER_JARFILE} "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

if [ ! -f ${SERVER_JARFILE} ] || [ ! -s ${SERVER_JARFILE} ]; then
	echo -e "ERROR: Download failed or the resulting file is empty."
	exit 1
fi

if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
    echo -e "Downloading MC server.properties"
    curl --user-agent "Pterodactyl (https://Pterodactyl.io)" -o server.properties https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pterodactyl/game-eggs/main/minecraft/java/server.properties
fi

echo -e "Installation completed successfully."

variables.description:

Must match a version that exists on the MohistMC API.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the server jarfile to run the server with.

variables.name: Download Path
variables.description: A URL to use to download a server.jar rather than the ones in the install script. This is not user viewable.

variables.name: Build Number
variables.description:
Specific build id to download.

Leave as "latest" (or empty) to always get the newest build for the chosen version.
